Description
The 5 Gram PAMP Suisse gold bar – Lady Fortuna, is one of the first, finest, and full-length bar designs in the recent era, produced by
PAMP
(Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux), the world’s leading precious metal refiner. Lady Fortuna Gold bars is one of the most popular collections of the PAMP Suisse. They have no imperfections in them, as they are produced by using the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.
PAMP Suisse in Switzerland produces these 5 gram gold bars, and the company has some of the finest transparency and authenticity standards in the gold industry (as well as one of the most remarkable facilities in the world). They’ve held that title for more than 35 years, having started producing some of the world’s best bars and ingots as early as 1977. PAMP gold bars are produced using the highest Swiss engineering skills at a modern, state-of-the-art-refinery with the best assurance of consistent quality excellence.
The 5 gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna contains 5 grams of gold of purity .9999 and includes an Assay Certificate that guarantees the weight and purity of the gold.
This bar also has world-class
Veriscan® Technology
, which instantly authenticates the gold bars to help reduce the risk of counterfeit bars. Each bar is scanned upon production and, when scanned by the customer, is further authenticated via the Veriscan® database.
Design of 5 Gram Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna
The PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Gold Bar is the first series to enter the precious metal market with an artistic image on the front of each bar and is famous for its beauty and design all over the world. These gold bars are easy to trade and liquidate as they are globally recognized for its design.
The Roman Goddess, Lady Fortuna who is believed to be the goddess of luck and fortune according to Roman mythology is portrayed blindfolded with all of her mythical attributes such as Sheaves of wheat, poppies, Horn of plenty, precious coins, wheel of fortune and  Cornucopia on the obverse.
The company’s unique PAMP emblem which consists of the words “PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the term “Suisse” just beneath it is depicted on the reverse side of these gold bars. The weight, purity, metal content, assayers mark, and the unique serial number is also inscribed on the reverse side of this 5g gold bar.
Main Highlights of 5 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
Contains 5 gram(0.1607 oz) of .9999 fine gold.
Produced by the world’s leading swiss precious metal refiner, PAMP.
Individual gold bars come in a protective plastic package along with its original assay card.
Veriscan Technology is used to provide additional protection and authenticity to the gold bars.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Features the Roman Goddess, Lady Fortuna the goddess of luck and fortune inscribed on the obverse.
Features the PAMP emblem along with the weight, purity, metal content, and unique serial number inscribed on the reverse.
Each gold bar is individually serialized.
